race.comment: FRANKED UP (1) looks a strong chance on debut after the horse to beat scratches. He's got three trials behind him, a close second at Horsham most recently and first-time blinkers applied for the McEvoy yard who strike well at home. BELLA ATHENA (5) is another first starter with enough trial grounding, including a close second at Pakenham, and the Hayes stable have to be respected. WHITEBAIT (4) has been below market expectation in two Mdn runs, but he was wide on debut at Geelong and is now third-up from a kinder draw, so a sharper showing would not surprise. MISS CAPRI (7) is coming along okay and has minor claims.
